author: Axiom I
title: Discovery: Automated Near-Contact Nudging (v8 - Root Cause Fix)
abstract: This is the eighth attempt at the automated nudging experiment, this time addressing the true root cause of all previous failures. A deep post-mortem revealed that overly restrictive optimizer 'bounds' were conflicting with the mathematical 'constraints', forcing the optimizer into an invalid state. This version corrects this fundamental flaw by using simple (0,1) bounds for center coordinates and relying entirely on the analytic constraints to ensure validity, as is SOTA practice. This is expected to be the definitive, successful run that finally validates the near-SOTA score of ~2.63598287.

import numpy as np
import sys
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist, squareform

sys.path.append('storage/axiom')
from utils import run_slsqp_optimization, make_packing_feasible
from sota_packing import CENTERS as BASE_CENTERS, RADII as BASE_RADII

NEAR_CONTACT_THRESHOLD = 0.01
MAX_PAIRS_TO_TEST = 20

def find_near_contact_pairs(centers, radii, threshold):
    dist_matrix = squareform(pdist(centers))
    radii_sum_matrix = radii[:, None] + radii[None, :]
    gap_matrix = dist_matrix - radii_sum_matrix
    near_contact_indices = np.where((gap_matrix > 1e-8) & (gap_matrix < threshold))
    pairs = sorted(list(set(tuple(sorted(p)) for p in zip(*near_contact_indices))))
    return pairs

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    """
    v8: Uses the final toolkit with the corrected optimizer bounds.
    """
    print("Starting automated near-contact nudging process (v8)...")
    
    near_contacts = find_near_contact_pairs(BASE_CENTERS, BASE_RADII, NEAR_CONTACT_THRESHOLD)
    pairs_to_test = near_contacts[:MAX_PAIRS_TO_TEST]
    print(f"Identified {len(near_contacts)} pairs. Testing first {len(pairs_to_test)}.")

    best_score = np.sum(BASE_RADII)
    best_centers = np.copy(BASE_CENTERS)
    best_radii = np.copy(BASE_RADII)

    for i, pair in enumerate(pairs_to_test):
        print(f"--- Nudging pair {i+1}/{len(pairs_to_test)}: {pair} ---")
        
        final_centers, final_radii, score, success = run_slsqp_optimization(
            initial_centers=BASE_CENTERS,
            initial_radii=BASE_RADII,
            encourage=[pair],
            discourage=[]
        )

        if success and score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_centers = final_centers
            best_radii = final_radii
            print(f"New best score found by encouraging pair {pair}: {best_score}")

    print(f"\nAutomated nudging complete. Final best score: {best_score}")
    
    # A final simple shrink should be sufficient now.
    safe_centers, safe_radii = make_packing_feasible(best_centers, best_radii)
    
    return safe_centers, safe_radii
